record.kind: marker passive with no PassiveEffects entry and no other behavioural reference; the orb evolution is a separate evolutionRule on the unit classes
record.summary: Passive.PRIMAL has no PassiveEffects entry and no code outside the three unit classes reads it (grep of app/ excluding public/ for Passive.PRIMAL returns only GROUDON, KYOGRE and RAYQUAZA). The passive itself has no combat or economy effect; its only description is flavour text. What the three units do share is an ITEM evolution rule on their class: GROUDON evolves into PRIMAL_GROUDON with a RED_ORB, KYOGRE into PRIMAL_KYOGRE with a BLUE_ORB and RAYQUAZA into MEGA_RAYQUAZA with a GREEN_ORB. That evolution is handled by ItemEvolutionHandler (it needs the orb among the unit's held items or dishes and no EVIOLITE) and is triggered when an item is acquired, not by the passive. The evolved forms use different passives (DROUGHT_OR_SANDSTORM for Primal Groudon, RAIN_OR_STORM for Primal Kyogre, AIRLOCK for Mega Rayquaza) and add the PRIMAL title on acquisition. The orb items' own combat effects (for example RED_ORB true-damage share) are item effects, not part of this passive.
